articles.title: Coinbase to launch token-backed mortgage down payments this summer
articles.snippet: A Coinbase-Better Home & Finance initiative will allow qualified borrowers to use Bitcoin and USDC as collateral for home loan down payments.

articles.title: Fannie Mae-Backed Bitcoin Home Mortgages Are Finally Here, Coinbase Says
articles.snippet: Coinbase said a Michigan couple closed on the first-ever conventional, Fannie Mae-backed home mortgage by pledging Bitcoin as collateral.
